title: The UX of AI Chat is Broken
excerpt: A visual breakdown of the fundamental design flaws in current conversational user interfaces: the thread trap, tool lock-in, context amnesia and the trust gap. The proposed direction is not a smarter chatbot but a continuous UI built around persistent workspaces.
bodyMarkdown:
**5 Fundamental Design Flaws in Current CUIs**

## 1. The Thread Trap

Current AI chats force a new thread for every single topic change.

It's rigid, disrupts your flow, and isolates your ideas.

## 2. Tool Lock-In

Start with an image? You're stuck there.

Switching to code or writing often requires a fresh start, killing your momentum instantly.

## 3. Context Amnesia

Your history becomes a graveyard of scattered chats.

There is no persistent workspace, only fragmented memories you can't easily search.

## 4. The Trust Gap

One "hallucination" breaks the spell.

Users are forced to double-check everything, completely negating the efficiency gains of AI.

## The Solution: Continuous UI

We need persistent workspaces, not just smarter chatbots.
